en.html:
Troublesome guest? Common sense had not even begun describing the matter. A peaceful town she could turn into a battlefield in an instant, depending on her mood. Who welcomed such a guest?

Fight. Run. Hide somewhere and wait for her to leave. One of those was the proper response.
You survive a natural disaster, and then: arre, where are you going, please stay? Your own good fortune you are throwing away.

Earthquake ji, one more night. We have hardly had time to get acquainted. Which room would you prefer? The upstairs room is downstairs now? No difficulty, we shall adjust. Hospitality should have some stopping point before a man began apologising to the calamity for the condition of the house it had demolished.

...That was why, even when I suspected somebody might be sheltering Hikaru, I could not make the idea feel real...

en.html:
...Chachamaru Ashikaga also did not seem to be lying.
But unlike Hikaru, she was a political ruler. Lies and clever evasions would be everyday tools for her. This innocent surface, I could not simply swallow it whole.

Probably the gratitude was real.
Only, the WHOLE reason? That I could not believe.

Some other reason was keeping Hikaru here. That seemed the sensible reading.

Two possibilities came to mind.

First: she knew how to dominate Hikaru. Control her, make her move according to her own wishes.
...No. For that nonsense, deep consideration was not required.

Her will's direction, Hikaru would not hand over to anybody. Silver Star, even less so. Force her, persuade her—another person controlling her seemed entirely impossible.

Besides, the two people in front of me were not behaving like that at all. Chachamaru did not interfere too much. That seemed to be exactly why Hikaru found this manor comfortable.

Then?

...The second possibility?

No need to control her in the first place. Hikaru simply being here served the Kubo's interests.

————Was that the matter?

ja.html:
……足利茶々丸もやはり、嘘を言っているようには
見えない。
　光と違い、虚言詭弁は常套手段であろう政治権力者
の事、上辺の印象を鵜呑みにはできないが……。

　おそらく、恩を受けたというのは真実。
　しかし、それのみとは考えられない。

　何か別に理由があって、光を留めている。
　そうみるのが妥当だ。

　咄嗟に思い付く理由は二つ。

　一つは、光を支配――制御する方法を心得ており、
自分の意のままに動かせるから。
　……しかしこれは深く検討するまでもなく<ruby>的外れ<rt>ナンセンス</rt></ruby>で
ある。

　己の意思の矛先を他人に委ねる光ではない。
〝銀星号〟なら尚更だ。実力をもってにせよ、口舌を
もってにせよ、他者が彼女を操るなど全く不可能な事
だろう。

　そもそも、いま目の当たりにしている両者の関係は
とてもそんな風には見えない。
　足利茶々丸は光に過度の干渉をせず、なればこそ、
光もこの館を過ごしやすいと感じているようだ。

　では？

　……もう一つの理由か？

　<ruby>支配制御などするまでもなく<rt>・・・・・・・・・・・・・</rt></ruby>、光の存在が堀越公方
の利益に適うから。

　――――なのか？
